note: CourtListener court ids (lexflow.municipal.caselaw.COURTS, named in case_law.court) that are the same court as a body of fixtures/authority/ladders.json. graph.py builds one item under the ladder's key and keeps the CourtListener name as an alias; an id not listed here gets lexflow:agency:<st>:court_<id>. Only courts whose names confirm the identity are listed; ny:nyappdiv (Appellate Division) is left out because the ladder holds it as an office type, not a court item, and md:md (Court of Appeals of Maryland, now the Supreme Court of Maryland) has no ladder body.
